title: Southern Farmhouse
description: A real two-storey farmhouse, brought into 3D from its architectural drawings.
assumptions: Converted from the Southern Farmhouse 1st and 2nd floor plans (sheets A1.1 and A1.2), scaled from their printed dimensions.
Ceiling heights come from the drawing set. The main roof is simplified to a gable on the upper walls; the porch roofs keep their drawn 2.5:12 slope. Porch screens are shown as low rails.
This is a sample conversion for exploring the layout, not construction documentation.
attribution: Southern Farmhouse, a design by Jay Osborne (freefarmhouse.com), shared under CC BY-SA 4.0. Converted into this interactive 3D model, which is shared under the same licence.
permissionEvidence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0, printed on every sheet of the 2022-06-27 drawing set. Chosen as the example home by the owner on 5 October 2026.
